text: Stewie, look! My coding assistant shut down again 'cause I hit my stupid API budget!
Oh stop your crying, Peter. Just plug OmniRoute into Cursor. It routes your code through sixty free AI models with automatic fallback.
Wait, free models? Like I can keep coding and not pay anything?!
Yes, you brilliant ape! If one provider goes down or throttles you, it instantly switches to another without skipping a beat.
Holy crap, that's genius! Does it work on my machine right now?!
It has a desktop app, Peter. Search ChrisCompton slash omniroute on GitHub and stop whining.
